ModMetaData.name: Insight - Test Runner
ModMetaData.author: Skyl3lazer
ModMetaData.description: A generic, dev-only in-game manual + self-checking test harness for RimWorld mods. Any mod can register test suites (via an ITestProvider or TestRegistry.Register) and step through them against a pawn, with PASS/FAIL checks and a JSON report. Holds no mod-specific content. Not for release.
